players.bio: Agustín Palavecino (born 9 November 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Liga MX club Cruz Azul.

Carlos Alberto Peña Rodríguez (born 29 March 1990) is a Mexican footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX side Cruz Azul, on loan from Rangers, and the Mexico national team. Born in Ciudad Victoria, Tamaulipas, Peña graduated from C.F. Pachuca's youth categories, and made his first-team debut on 14 April 2010.
Carlos Alberto Rodríguez Gómez (born 3 January 1997) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Liga MX club Monterrey and the Mexico national team.
Emmanuel "Emi" Ochoa is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Cruz Azul.
Érik Antonio Lira Méndez (born 8 May 2000) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Liga MX club Cruz Azul, which he captains, and the Mexico national team.
Jesús Gilberto Orozco Chiquete (born 19 February 2002), commonly known as "Chiquete Orozco", is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Guadalajara.
Jorge Rodarte Barragán (born 23 April 2004) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Cruz Azul.
José Antonio Paradela (born 15 December 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for River Plate.

Kevin Leonardo Mier Robles (born 18 May 2000) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Liga MX club Cruz Azul and the Colombia national team. Mier began his career at Atlético Nacional, making his senior debut in 2019. That same year he spent a brief loan spell at Santa Fe, followed in 2020 by a loan at Valledupar to gain first-team experience.

Luka Romero Bezzana (born 18 November 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder and winger for Liga MX club Cruz Azul. Born in Mexico, he represented Argentina at the youth international level.

Omar Antonio Campos Chagoya (born 20 July 2002) is a Mexican professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Liga MX club Cruz Azul. Born in Cuauhtémoc district of Mexico City, Campos grew up in the Tepito neighborhood before joining the youth setup at Santos Laguna in 2016.
Willer Emilio Ditta Pérez (born 23 January 1997) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Liga MX club Cruz Azul and the Colombia national team.
